descriptionHtml:
MSI A520M-A PRO motherboard:

​Core Specifications

  • ​Socket: AM4
  • ​Chipset: AMD A520
  • ​Form Factor: Micro-ATX (mATX)
  • ​CPU Support: Supports AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series, 5000 G-Series, 4000 G-Series, 3000 Series, and 3000 G-Series desktop processors.

​Memory (RAM)

  • ​Slots: 2x DDR4 DIMM slots
  • ​Max Capacity: 64 GB
  • ​Speed: Supports up to 4600(OC) MHz.
  • ​Architecture: Dual Channel

​Expansion Slots

  • ​Primary Slot: 1x PCIe 3.0 x16 slot
  • ​Secondary Slot: 1x PCIe 3.0 x1 slot

​Storage

  • ​M.2 Slot: 1x Turbo M.2 slot (Key M), supports PCIe 3.0 x4 & SATA 6Gb/s.
  • ​SATA Ports: 4x SATA 6Gb/s ports.
  • ​RAID: Supports RAID 0, RAID 1, and RAID 10.

​Rear I/O Ports

  • ​Video: 1x HDMI 2.1, 1x DVI-D.
  • ​USB: 4x USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5Gbps) Type-A, 2x USB 2.0 Type-A.
  • ​Networking: 1x Realtek® RTL8111H Gigabit LAN.
  • ​Audio: 3x Audio jacks.
  • ​Legacy: 1x PS/2 Keyboard/Mouse combo port.

​Internal Connectors

  • ​1x 24-pin ATX power / 1x 4-pin ATX 12V power.
  • ​1x USB 3.2 Gen 1 connector.
  • ​2x USB 2.0 connectors.
  • ​1x 4-pin CPU fan / 1x 4-pin System fan.
